change: Tightened height harmonization thresholds from 110%/88% to 105%/93%
lesson: Metric gaming: visual quality degraded despite score improvement. 'The' rendered as 'Tle'. Thresholds must not be tightened beyond 110%/88%.

change: Fold normalize/equalize/harmonize-height passes into one scale per word, one resample (same decisions, measured once on raw images)
expected: final ink heights within +/-1px for >= 90% of words; short all-body words keep dark ink; 'by' legible
lesson: Height prediction falsified: short words land 2-4px taller because int() truncation and ink-threshold erosion no longer shave pixels at each resample. Darkness was the wrong instrument (stroke-weight harmonization re-darkens everything); the damage was blur. Visual check: 'by' went from smudge to legible.
